## The algorithm adds contact supervision before policy evaluation {data-style-preview="unmasked"}

<span class="kicker">Algorithm</span>

::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="66%"}
```text
for batch in demonstrations:
    pose, wrench, action = batch
    contact = label_contact(wrench, threshold)
    loss = pose_loss(pose, action)
    loss += lambda_contact * contact_loss(contact)
    update(policy, loss)

evaluate(policy, held_out_disturbances)
```
